verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a skills and plugin package that agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Pi install. It is not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only skills installed via the `skills` CLI, plugin metadata, and the `yy ledger` CLI commands; nothing documents an MCP server or endpoint that agents could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
